package: nLab Framework 1.2.0 — Search, Data Views & Multi-source Patterns
purpose: Intégrer les enseignements génériques des Recettes du Cœur et un premier audit prudent de Last War, en complément des briques déjà extraites de MadaNotes.
recipes_extracted: query normalization, stopwords, weak words, wildcards and token chips
cards/list/table result views and card density
reference ID resolution and field-level help
semantic status colors independent from dominant theme color
lastwar_extracted: hash navigation that reopens collapsed ancestors
merge_strategy: MadaNotes remains the strongest reference for toolbar/floating help/windowing.
Recipes becomes the strongest reference for search/data-editor patterns.
Last War contributes long-document/sidebar patterns but remains experimental.
No business scorer, business label, repository identity or project URL is copied into generic components.
